description: Deterministic probe cases for the gjc-plugin domain. Each case is scored against <repoDir>/jev-advisor/lib/decision.ts without any model or network calls. Provenance-sourced headroom: decision_accuracy cases added in the M2 headroom commit carry a `provenance` object naming the documented statement they operationalize; held-out parallels carry `parallelOf`.

provenance.statement: A supplied probability distribution must contain exactly the three tiers, finite probabilities in [0,1], and sum to one within 0.001.
provenance.note: decimal sum 0.9989999999999999 differs from one by exactly the documented tolerance; binary floating-point addition currently pushes |sum-1| just past it
